schemaNotice: 專案圓餅圖能力契約，非B4A原生schema；只登錄已審閱來源，匯入JSON不能執行程式。雜湊不取代幾何、數據或瀏覽器驗收。
name: Native3DPieChart
dependencies: native BuildingStore and existing material whitelist
registration: Explicit trusted module imports, ASSETS registry, strict native model fields and registered sector.configure agent command. Existing B4A controls load, inspect and export native scenes.

inputs.chart: title, period, unit, source{name,url}, data[{id,name,value}]; 1–40 unique names/IDs, finite non-negative values and positive safe total.
inputs.sector: Native chart-sector prop contains sector{startAngle,endAngle}, degrees, 0 <= start < end <= 360. Circular equal width/depth <=8; horizontal pitch/roll; existing height/elevation/rotation/color fields.
inputs.command: sector.configure accepts only id/startAngle/endAngle in trusted model and agent registries.
inputs.snapshot: Population CLI reuses same verified 22-county snapshot and original RIS ODS SHA; no network refresh.

outputs: Validated native building with circular-arc extruded sectors of equal radius/thickness
Same-data source SHA, original shares, angles, displayed percent and object/color index
Horizontal world-text legend with county, exact population and percent
Native JSON/full project, CSV, retained data and official ODS

authority.read: Explicit local aggregate population snapshot and original ODS evidence.
authority.write: Generated local artifacts and validated in-memory scene changes only; no database, account, IAM or original draft changes.
authority.externalModels: chart-sector and text-panel cannot be replaced by GLB, preserving angle/text semantics.

geometry.palette: Deterministic opaque category colors, one material and shared roughness.
geometry.tinyOrZero: No minimum-share inflation or other grouping; zero keeps legend only.
geometry.tessellation: Bounded circular-arc ExtrudeGeometry; finite mesh approximation tested against original share.

interaction: Native 2D arc drawing and exact per-sector picking use same angles; spawn/teleport and thin-body collision use true sector footprint. Rotation/mirror and native roundtrip preserve sector data.
lifecycle: Geometry/material allocation follows existing per-scene ownership and disposal. Existing text-panel maps are bounded and disposed.
errors: Invalid dimensions, tilt, angles, material/data, unknown command fields or locked-object changes reject atomically.
limitations: Single-series generator, no live spreadsheet binding.
Manual geometry/material edits do not recalculate original population or legend.
Displayed percentages are rounded to two decimals; this dataset sums to100.02% displayed, raw shares sum to100%.
Perspective alters apparent area; top view and numeric labels support comparison.
rollback: Retain raw data and old bar-chart files; revert new module/asset registration and remove or migrate chart-sector objects before using an older viewer.
